profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); democratic institutions mixed (zero)
summary: Marinduque representative with about 45 principal-authored bills on energy regulation, building resilience, migrant-worker reintegration, line-worker insurance, free professional exams for indigents and a nutrition program. Authored an anti-dynasty ban and also a bill postponing barangay and SK elections. Authored a travel-tax abolition and an emergency-response framework with presidential powers.
caveat: Bill-list evidence only. HB09305 (emergency framework and presidential powers) was described generically and is not scored; read in full it could shift the democratic score. The anti-dynasty bill is a common coalition bill.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored electricity lifeline-rate expansion (-2), mandatory insurance for line workers (-2), and free professional exams for indigents plus a national nutrition program (-2). Travel-tax abolition and ERC restructuring show no clear direction. Three issues, bill-based only.
